Name: stanloona420's Alex Revised for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
stanloona420's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11321]Alex Revised[/url] mod is probably my favorite portrait for Alex but it didn't have seasonals. Permissions were open, as well as for Alex's Seasonal Cute assets, so I decided to go for it!
Artwork involved are by stanloona420, Pereira1495, and Poltergeister

Simply download and overwrite Seasonal Cute's original assets.

Enjoy!
